pages.text: Power the machine and install a capacitor.

Place a valid template in the input slot and the block whose appearance you want in the paint slot. Use one vanilla Crafting Table and a Diamond Block to make one diamond-painted crafting table. A stock batch costs 2,400 FE.

The result keeps the template’s function. Paint fences, stairs, slabs, or other supported templates to match the room. For hidden routing, paint a $(l:enderio:conduits/facades)conduit facade$(/l). Separate the paint sample and input when feeding the slots.
